info.scriptSrcText: global gPausedon exitFrame me  go(the frame)endon keyDown  if the keyCode = 35 then    if gPaused = 1 then      gPaused = 0      sound(1).play()      sound(2).play()      sound(3).play()      sound(4).play()    else      gPaused = 1      sound(1).pause()      sound(2).pause()      sound(3).pause()      sound(4).pause()    end if  end ifend
